2. Set up plot themes
```{r}
# Project directory
clusterRoot <- "/n/whipple_lab/share_root/Users/cwhilden/PROJECTS/THESIS/chapter2_RMS"
macRoot     <- "/Volumes/whipple_lab/Users/cwhilden/PROJECTS/THESIS/chapter2_RMS"

# PLOT THEME
paletteCW <- c(
  Pink_CW      = "#EC008C",
  Teal_CW      = "#008C8C",
  Charcoal_CW  = "#2E2E2E",
  LimeGreen_CW = "#9BC53D",
  SoftOrange_CW= "#F4A261",
  Purple_CW    = "#7B2CBF"
)

themeCW <- function(baseSize = 6) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = baseSize) %+replace%
    theme(
      # panel
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "black", size = 0.5),
      
      # axes lines/ticks/text
      axis.line = element_blank(),                      # border handles the visual frame
      axis.ticks = element_line(size = 0.5),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.03, "in"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = baseSize, colour = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = baseSize, colour = "black"),
      
      # legend
      legend.key        = element_blank(),
      legend.background = element_blank(),
      legend.text       = element_text(size = baseSize),
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      
      legend.key.size   = unit(0.2, "cm"),
      legend.spacing.y  = unit(1, "pt"),
      legend.margin     = margin(0, 0, 0, 0, unit = "pt"),
      legend.position = "top",
      
      # plot text & margins
      plot.title = element_text(size = baseSize, colour = "black"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = baseSize, colour = "black"),
      plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5, unit = "pt"),
      
      aspect.ratio=1
    )
}


######################################
# Function to save plots in my preferred size
plotSave <- function(plotVar, fileName, outSave=outDir, w=1.5, h=1.5){
  ggsave(
  filename = file.path(outSave,fileName),
  plot = plotVar,
  device = "pdf",
  width = w,
  height = h,
  units = "in"
  )
}
```

3. Read in rRNA data and annotations
rRNA 
```{r}
RMS_dir<-"/Volumes/whipple_lab/Users/cwhilden/PROJECTS/THESIS/chapter2_RMS/results/rmsScores/rRNA"
Nm<-read_csv("/Volumes/whipple_lab/Users/cwhilden/PIPELINE/ribomethseq/data/mouseNmSites.csv") %>%
  mutate(ID=paste(TARGET,POSITION,sep="_"))

dataFiles<-list.files(path = RMS_dir, 
                        pattern = "\\.rms.txt$", 
                        full.names = TRUE)

# Extract sample/snoRNA information from filename
names<-sub("\\.rms.txt$","",basename(dataFiles))

# generate a named list of data
data <- purrr::set_names(dataFiles, names) %>%
  purrr::map(~ readr::read_tsv(.x))

# Merge named list into a single data frame
merged_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(data, .id = "sample")  %>%
  tidyr::separate(sample, 
                  into = c("condition", "tissue", "sampleid"), 
                  sep  = "_") %>%
  filter(chrom=='45S_Rn45s',
         tissue=='CTX' | tissue=='iN') %>%
  mutate(
    ID    = paste(chrom, position, sep = "_"),
    status = if_else(ID %in% Nm$ID, 'known Nm', 'unknown')) %>%
    mutate(site_status=case_when(position>=10415 & position<=10427 ~ "aseD",
                         position>=11961 & position<=11971 ~ "aseDp",
                         status == 'known Nm' ~ 'Nm',
                
                         TRUE ~ "other")) %>%
  # Only keep scores for nucleotides with high coverage
  filter(coverage>=10000 & site_status != 'other') %>%
  mutate(group=paste0(condition,"_",tissue))

```
# Heat map
```{r}
heatmap <- merged_data %>%
  mutate(sampleFull = paste(condition, tissue, sampleid, sep = '_')) %>%
  filter(site_status == 'Nm' ) %>%
  mutate(
    condition = factor(condition, levels = c("DEL","KD", "CTL")),
    tissue    = factor(tissue,    levels = c("iNeuron", "CTX"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(tissue, condition, sampleid) %>%          # DEL rows first, CTL rows last
  mutate(
    sampleFull = factor(sampleFull, levels = unique(sampleFull))  # lock in that order
  )

plot_heat<-ggplot(heatmap,
       aes(x    = factor(position),
           y    = sampleFull,
           fill = RMS)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low     = "blue",
    mid     = "white",
    high    = "magenta",
    midpoint = 0.5
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ tissue, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x    = "45S rRNA pos: known Nm",
    y    = "Sample",
    fill = "RMS Score",
    title = "RMS Score by Position and Sample"
  ) + theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size=4))

outDir<-file.path(macRoot,"plots")

plotSave(plot_heat,"Heatmap_knownNm.pdf",h=4,w=6)
plot_heat
```






```{r}
# Summary table: mean RMS and SEM per position and condition
rms_summary <- merged_data %>%
  group_by(chrom, position, ID, site_status, group) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_rms = mean(RMS, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_rms   = sd(RMS, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    n        = n(),
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols     = c(position, ID, site_status),
    names_from  = group,
    values_from = c(mean_rms, se_rms)
  )

```


Plot known Nm sites: iNeurons v. cortex
```{r}
# ── Step 1: count quadrants BEFORE nm is overwritten by ggplot ────────────────
quadrant_counts <- nm %>%
  mutate(
    quadrant = case_when(
      mean_rms_CTL_CTX >= 0.5 & mean_rms_CTL_iN >= 0.5 ~ "top_right",
      mean_rms_CTL_CTX <  0.5 & mean_rms_CTL_iN >= 0.5 ~ "top_left",
      mean_rms_CTL_CTX <  0.5 & mean_rms_CTL_iN <  0.5 ~ "bottom_left",
      mean_rms_CTL_CTX >= 0.5 & mean_rms_CTL_iN <  0.5 ~ "bottom_right"
    )
  ) %>%
  count(quadrant)

print(quadrant_counts)

# ── Step 2: build plot with counts annotated in each quadrant ─────────────────
nm_plot <- ggplot(nm,
       aes(x = mean_rms_CTL_CTX,
           y = mean_rms_CTL_iN)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_rms_CTL_iN - se_rms_CTL_iN,
        ymax = mean_rms_CTL_iN + se_rms_CTL_iN),
    width = 0, alpha = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = mean_rms_CTL_CTX - se_rms_CTL_CTX,
        xmax = mean_rms_CTL_CTX + se_rms_CTL_CTX),
    height = 0, alpha = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5) +
  
  # ── quadrant labels ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  annotate("text", x = 0.9,  y = 0.95,
           label = quadrant_counts$n[quadrant_counts$quadrant == "top_right"],
           hjust = 0.5, fontface = "bold") +
  annotate("text", x = 0.1,  y = 0.95,
           label = quadrant_counts$n[quadrant_counts$quadrant == "top_left"],
           hjust = 0.5, fontface = "bold") +
  annotate("text", x = 0.1,  y = 0.05,
           label = quadrant_counts$n[quadrant_counts$quadrant == "bottom_left"],
           hjust = 0.5, fontface = "bold") +
  annotate("text", x = 0.9,  y = 0.05,
           label = quadrant_counts$n[quadrant_counts$quadrant == "bottom_right"],
           hjust = 0.5, fontface = "bold") +
  
  themeCW()

outDir<-file.path(macRoot,"plots")
dir.create(outDir, recursive=TRUE)

plotSave(nm_plot,"Nm_Ctx_v_iNeurons.pdf")
```

Function to plot RMS data w/ labelled quadrants
```{r}
plot_rms_quadrants <- function(
    data,
    x_col,
    y_col,
    threshold  = 0.5,
    point_size = 1.5,
    filename   = NULL,
    outDir=file.path(macRoot, "plots")
) {
  
  # ── pull SE column names from x/y mean column names ────────────────────────
  x_se <- sub("mean_rms", "se_rms", x_col)
  y_se <- sub("mean_rms", "se_rms", y_col)
  
  # ── Step 1: count quadrants ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  quadrant_counts <- data %>%
    mutate(
      quadrant = case_when(
        .data[[x_col]] >= threshold & .data[[y_col]] >= threshold ~ "top_right",
        .data[[x_col]] <  threshold & .data[[y_col]] >= threshold ~ "top_left",
        .data[[x_col]] <  threshold & .data[[y_col]] <  threshold ~ "bottom_left",
        .data[[x_col]] >= threshold & .data[[y_col]] <  threshold ~ "bottom_right"
      )
    ) %>%
    count(quadrant)
  
  print(quadrant_counts)
  
  # ── helper: safely pull count (returns 0 if quadrant absent) ────────────────
  get_n <- function(q) {
    val <- quadrant_counts$n[quadrant_counts$quadrant == q]
    if (length(val) == 0) return(0) else return(val)
  }
  
  # ── Step 2: build plot ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  p <- ggplot(data,
              aes(x = .data[[x_col]],
                  y = .data[[y_col]])) +
    geom_point(size = point_size) +
    
    # ── fix: simple arithmetic inside aes() ───────────────────────────────────
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = .data[[y_col]] - .data[[y_se]],
          ymax = .data[[y_col]] + .data[[y_se]]),
      width = 0, alpha = 0.4
    ) +
    geom_errorbarh(
      aes(xmin = .data[[x_col]] - .data[[x_se]],
          xmax = .data[[x_col]] + .data[[x_se]]),
      height = 0, alpha = 0.4
    ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = threshold) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = threshold) +
    
    annotate("text", x = 0.9, y = 0.95, hjust = 0.5, fontface = "bold",
             label = get_n("top_right")) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.1, y = 0.95, hjust = 0.5, fontface = "bold",
             label = get_n("top_left")) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.1, y = 0.05, hjust = 0.5, fontface = "bold",
             label = get_n("bottom_left")) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.9, y = 0.05, hjust = 0.5, fontface = "bold",
             label = get_n("bottom_right")) +
    
    labs(x = x_col, y = y_col) +
    themeCW()
  
  # ── Step 3: save using your original plotSave style ─────────────────────────
  if (!is.null(filename)) {
    
    dir.create(outDir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    plotSave(p, filename, outSave=outDir)                  # ← matches your original usage
  }
  
  return(p)
}
```

## Statistics
- Comparing RMS scores between CTL / DEL cortex and CTL / KD iNeurons at high-RMS score sites and known Nm sites

Cortex
```{r}
df_stat_cortex <- merged_data %>%
  select(all_of(c(
    'condition',
    'tissue',
    'sampleid',
    'position',
    'RMS',
    'site_status'
  ))) %>%
  filter(tissue=='CTX',
         RMS >0)


# Safe wrapper
safe_wilcox <- possibly(
  ~ wilcox_test(.x, RMS ~ condition),
  otherwise = NULL
)

# Keep position label when splitting
wilcox_ctx <- df_stat_cortex %>%
  group_by(position) %>%
  group_map(function(x, key) {
    result <- safe_wilcox(x)
    if (!is.null(result)) {
      result$position <- key$position   # ← key automatically contains group label
    }
    result
  }) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "bonferroni") %>%
  add_significance()


head(wilcox_ctx)
```
